Headquarters: United States, Remote

Job Title: People Operations Generalist 

Location: United States, Remote

THE OPPORTUNITY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our People Operations Generalist is a pivotal part of our success as the go-to for all employee relations. You will work closely with managers to ensure flawless execution of employee support across the organization, and — with the help of the broader People team — manage employee questions, concerns, and offboarding, including investigations, exit surveys, and interviews. You will analyze trends in employee patterns and partner with the Director to execute strategies that support the long-term success of the business, and lead the creation and maintenance of company policies and compliance.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

- Serve as the primary point of contact for employee relations matters, including investigations, exit surveys, and exit interviews.

- Manage the leave-of-absence process and tracking, ensuring compliance with local and federal law.

- Manage the offboarding process, including exit interviews for all departing employees.

- Partner closely with managers to ensure consistent, high-quality employee support across the organization.

- Analyze workforce trends and metrics to recommend action plans that improve engagement and retention.

- Lead the creation and maintenance of company policies and state compliance projects.

- Craft corporate communications that land clearly across all levels of the organization.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will have the opportunity to shape the employee experience for a fast-growing team. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a self-starting, organized individual who is passionate about contributing to the success of their peers and thrives in a fast-paced environment. You excel at juggling multiple priorities and thoroughly enjoy providing a white-glove employee experience.

If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming our People Operations Generalist is the career path for you!

THE TEAM

Our Salesloft People Operations team is a small but mighty team. We are passionate about providing the best possible onboarding experience for every new Lofter! The team consists of results-oriented professionals with the initiative to take on any challenge and serve their fellow team members.

The People Operations team's members share a few common traits: they are warm and welcoming, self-motivated, and excited to contribute to the professional development of every Salesloft employee.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

- Bachelor's degree

- 2+ years of professional experience in Human Resources, including employee relations and program management

- Strong ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a high-demand environment with professionalism and good judgment

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with experience interfacing with all levels of an organization

- High attention to detail and a high degree of empathy in supporting a positive, accommodating employee experience

Preferred:

- Experience with HiBob HRIS

- A passion for teamwork and contributing to the success and reputation of the broader People function

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team.

Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Learn more about our full range of benefits at salesloftbenefits.com.

#LI-HYBRID

It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.  The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.  

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. 
Base Pay Range
$60,000—$85,000 USD

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-people-operations-generalist

About Sarvam
Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

About the Role
The Senior Manager, Growth Marketing owns how more of the right people discover Sarvam, try it, activate, and become long-term users.
This is an end-to-end growth role spanning acquisition, developer adoption, conversion, lifecycle, and experimentation. The mandate is to build growth engines that compound, across search, content, community, paid channels, product-led loops, and the product funnel itself.
The work is measured not by traffic or clicks, but by quality signups, successful API usage, retention, and revenue. This person works closely with Product, Developer Relations, Content, Sales, and Analytics to understand where growth is coming from, remove friction across the funnel, and continuously find new ways to scale adoption.

Key Responsibilities
• 
Own the growth funnel. Own the journey from discovery → signup → first successful API call → habitual usage → paid conversion → team expansion. Understand where users drop, instrument the funnel, and systematically improve it.
• 
Drive acquisition. Grow high-quality acquisition across search, content, community, paid search, paid social, and new distribution channels. Build a balanced mix of channels that can scale efficiently over time.
• 
Grow developer adoption. Increase API usage and open-weight model adoption. Work closely with Product and DevRel on documentation, technical content, developer journeys, and product-led growth loops.
• 
Own search and discoverability. Build Sarvam's presence across traditional search, technical SEO, documentation SEO, and increasingly, AI-powered search and LLM answers.
• 
Improve activation and onboarding. Reduce the time between signup and first value. Design onboarding, lifecycle communication, product nudges, and experiments that help developers get to a successful first use case quickly.
• 
Drive conversion. Continuously improve landing pages, signup flows, pricing journeys, paywalls, and other conversion points that turn interest into usage and usage into revenue.
• 
Build retention and expansion loops. Identify the behaviours that predict long-term usage, churn, and account growth. Build lifecycle, re-engagement, retargeting, and product interventions around them.
• 
Run experimentation. Maintain a continuous backlog of growth experiments across acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention. Ship quickly, measure rigorously, and scale what works.
• 
Own growth economics. Understand acquisition efficiency across channels and cohorts. Own CAC, payback, LTV, attribution, and budget allocation, with a clear view of where the next incremental unit of growth should come from.
• 
Analytics and instrumentation. Define the metrics the growth team runs on, ensure the right events and funnels are instrumented, and build dashboards that make performance visible and actionable.
• 
Build AI-native workflows. Use AI across research, content, creative, SEO, targeting, experimentation, and analysis to compress cycles and operate a highly leveraged growth motion.
Requirements
• 
7–10 years of experience in growth marketing, with hands-on ownership of a PLG or self-serve funnel
• 
Track record of growing acquisition, activation, conversion, and revenue with quantified outcomes
• 
Strong hands-on understanding of both search/discoverability and paid acquisition
• 
Experience building content, community, SEO, or product-led growth loops that drove meaningful adoption
• 
Strong experimentation discipline; able to design, run, analyse, and act on experiments rigorously
• 
Comfort with analytics and instrumentation; able to define metrics, pull data, diagnose funnels, and understand CAC, payback, and LTV
• 
Experience marketing to developers or technical buyers
• 
Comfortable operating across both product and marketing surfaces rather than treating growth as a channel function
• 
Fluent in modern AI tools across research, creative, content, analytics, and growth workflows
Good to Have
• 
Experience growing an API, SDK, developer product, or open-weight/open-source model
• 
Deep familiarity with SEO, AI-powered search, and LLM discoverability
• 
Experience with lifecycle, retention, and conversion-rate optimisation
• 
Experience building a growth motion from scratch at a founder-led or early-stage company
• 
Familiarity with a self-serve developer motion and an enterprise sales motion running side by side
• 
Experience managing or mentoring growth, lifecycle, SEO, content, performance, or analytics contributors

Why Sarvam?
Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.
• 
Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
• 
High ownership and high impact, from day one
• 
Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
• 
You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates
If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.
